title: Sounds of home schooling lulling my attention to better spaces not sure. Maybe a metronome keeping time for the clarinet or a Pileated Pecker beating
summary: Sounds of home schooling lulling my attention to better spaces not sure. Maybe a metronome keeping time for the clarinet or a Pileated Pecker beating out a feast against the trees Strange harmonies in our home #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Sounds of home
schooling
lulling my attention
to better spaces
not sure. Maybe
a metronome
keeping time for the
clarinet or
a Pileated Pecker
beating out a feast
against the trees
Strange harmonies
in our home
#smallpoems
